tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ de bsgom par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du dpal gshin rje gshed bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du/ rang gi shes pa hūm̐ dmar po las/ rdo rje sngon po dang*/ mi mgo ser pos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur pa las 'od zer 'phros pa sems can thams cad la phog pas/ sems can thams cad gshin rje gshed dmar por gyur/ tshur 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ma he dmar po dang las kyi gshin rje khas phub tu bsgyel ba'i steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ zhabs g.yas bskum pas ma he'i rwa bar dang*/ g.yon brkyangs pas tshang ra'i steng du brdzis pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje mi mgo dang bcas pa'i dbyug pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar zhing*/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog dmar mo/

phyag g.yas pas gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo// gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsgom la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ gshin rje gshed rigs lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ de rnams la oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhū pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke/ badz+ra gan+dhe/ badz+ra nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod nas/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis/ ye shes kyi chus bdag gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing*/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs pas dbang gi chu rgyun spyi bo nas zhugs/ rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas gnyis ka'i spyi bor rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ dbang gi lha thams cad ye shes pa'i tshul gyis rang la gnyis su med par bstim pa dang*/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba dang*/ de'i thugs kar hūm̐ dmar po nas 'bras tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' dmigs nas/ yum gyi bha ga pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ yab kyi gsang gnas rdo rje rtse lnga par bskyed nas/ snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub sems kyi thig les yab yum gnyis char gyi sku yongs su gang nas/

rjes su chags pa las byung ba'i zag pa med pa'i bde bas gnyis ka mnyes par byas/ de'i stobs kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gnyis su med pa'i bde bas mnyes sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba dang ldan par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas thig le rnams ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtser mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med par gnas pas bdag nyid la mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ rak+ta ya mā ri ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ/ zhes pa la sogs pa brjod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod la mchod pa'i lha mo de dag rang gi thugs kar thim par bsam mo// de nas lha'i sku sems dpa' sum brtsegs de nyid la dmigs la yid mnyam par bzhag go /sngags zlo ba'i tshe snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du 'khor ba'i 'od kyis sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgyas/ phyir 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus pa bzla bar bya'o// spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad gshin rje gshed du bsgoms nas/ oṃ zhes pa dang*/ brjod pa dang grags pa thams cad sngags su bsgoms nas/ āḥzhes pa dang*/ sems kyi rtog pa thams cad ting nge 'dzin tu bsgoms la/ hūm̐ zhes pas dngos po thams cad lha'i ngo bo snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar dmigs la/ phyi'i lhas nang gi lha la mchod par bsam zhing ci bde bar longs spyad do// gtor ma gtong ba'i tshe/ gtor ma bshams pa/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/

a las thod pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bskyed la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i ya mān+ta ka la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ chos skyong ba dang*/ 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ de rnams kyis gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi wi kṛ tā na na rak+ta ya mā ri i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ma ma bigh+nan/ ha ra ha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod nas/ bdag gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// de nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod la gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol lo// zas za ba'i tshe/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gshin rje gshed du gsal bar dmigs pa'i thugs kar bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang*/ lto bar phyogs skyong ba dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad dmigs la/ de rnams la mchod pa'i bsam pas bza'o// rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ bskyed rim gyi bde ba bsgom pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o// nyal ba'i tshe stong pa'i ngang la nyal zhing ldang ba'i tshe/ skad cig gis lha'i skur ldang ngo*// de ltar rtag tu rnal 'byor du byed pa ni gnas skabs su bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing*/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du grub nas/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// rgyal bu a rog ches bskul nas// 'phags pas sgrub thabs sbyar ba yi// dge bas bdag dang sems can kun// gshin rje gshed dpal nyid gyur cig /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ chu pho spre'u lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin par shing kun gyi char sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ā tsa ra zhes bya'o//

༈ /gshin rje gshed dmar po lhan cig skyes pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga ye shes 'char ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ shin tu spros med lhan skyes kyi// ye shes mchog gi rnam rol ni// bla ma gshin rje mthar byed la// btud nas de yi byin rlabs bri// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas dben par stegs bu'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gcig pa dang*/ mchod gtor bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun tu bum pa bcud ldan/ rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod sogs dang*/ gzhan yang ral gri/ gri thod/ rdo rje'i dbyug pa sogs nye mkho thams cad 'du bya/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang skyabs sems spyi ltar sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā bas rang dang tshom bu gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag mdun lhan cig tu lhar bskyed pa nas/ bzlas pa'i bar chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs ltar nyams su blang*/ gtor ma bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las sogs nas/ 'jig rten pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs gtor mgron spyan drangs la sgrub thabs ltar gtor ma 'bul/ oṃ rak+ta ya mā ri sa pa ri wā ri ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod// sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa// sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal lo// gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs dang*/ bdag gi sogs nas/ 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ bum pa la dmigs te hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥci nus bzlas pas byin gyis brlab/ gnyis pa ni/ dbang gis smin pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod par sems bskyed gsal gdab la/ de la rnal 'byor bla med zhe sdang thabs rgyud dpal gshin rje gshed kyi skor la dmar nag 'jigs gsum du grags pa'i ya gyal/

rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po bir+wa pa'i man ngag mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skyes bu bar ma chad pa las rim par 'ongs pa'i bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po lhan cig skyes pa'i byin rlabs kyi rim pa zab mo sgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la skyabs yul thams cad kyis bskor ba mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs/ slar yang rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gis bsdus pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun sogs/ de nas byin rlabs kyi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du/ slob dpon la gus 'dud mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa slob dpon gshin rje gshed dmar po gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yum rdo rje ro langs ma'i mkha' gsang du lhungs pa las skad cig gis pad+ma dang nyi ma'i sogs nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku can re rer lam ste gyur pa la/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te dbang bskur/ slar yang mkha' gsang nas phyir spros te rang rang gi gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas slob dpon la gus 'dud mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/

khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥ'i mthar/ a be sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes btags pas ye shes dbab/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dbyer med du bstim/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas slob dpon dang dbang gi lha lhan cig pas bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba re thogs te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs nas/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpa' re res dbur brgyan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams kyang khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des bum pa'i dbang bskur byin rlabs kyi tshul gyis thob pa'o// gsang ba'i dbang gi slad du/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab/ bdud rtsi'i steng gi nam mkhar skad cig gi dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po yab yum gsal bar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig pa lce thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sprad la/ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥdang 'bru gsum bzla bzhin par slob ma la sbyin/ des gsang ba'i dbang thob pa'o// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du khyed rang rnams kyi lus lha sku gsal dwang 'ja' tshon lta bur snang ba dang*/ sems rgyud bdud rtsi'i ro myong bas brjod bral du shar ba la blo bzhag ste cung zad re mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa'o// dbang bzhi pa'i slad du/

grub chen bir+wa pas/ 'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa ste// rig pa'i de nyid ma 'gags pa// rang rig ye shes skad cig ma// 'di ni thog ma dbus mtha' med// ces gsungs te/ de'i don nyams su len pa lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag sems dang nam mkha' ro gcig tu bsres te gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ de ltar bzhag pas skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i gnyug ma'i ye shes bsam brjod las 'das par nyams su myong ba ni shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid de/ dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo'o// mtha' rten sngags kyi rjes gnang sbyin pa la rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis 'byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥsogs/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ dus de nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o// byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor ba dang bcas te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te spyi bor bzhag pas sngags kyi dngos grub brtan cing nus ldan du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs/ ral gri'i rjes gnang gi slad du/

hūm̐ las byung ba'i bdud thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i ral gri phyag g.yas su byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// las kyi ral gri mchog lta bu// bdud las rgyal bar bya phyir zungs/ mngon spyod kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du ma rungs pa tshar gcod pa'i gri gug phyag g.yas su byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ e ma ho gsod pa 'di ni bzang*// gsod pa gsod pa ma yin te// dam tshig la sdang bsad pa yin// sems can gnod byed bsad par bya// dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed la// bzod pa bsgom par mi bya'o// dam tshig la sdang dgra chen po// ngo mthon khyod kyis bsad par byos// brtul zhugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du/ bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa phyag g.yon tu byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ khams gsum kun gyi khrag chen po// ma rungs snying nas drongs byos la// khrag chen khyod kyis btung bar gyis// brtul zhugs mthar thug bla na med// phyag mtshan gyi rjes gnang gi slad du/ rdo rje'i dbyug pa phyag g.yas dang ka pā la g.yon tu byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gshin rje gshed po'i phyag rgya 'di// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// rdo rje'i dbyug pa ka pā la// dpa' bos yang dag bzung bar gyis// de nas mdun bskyed kyi dpal gshin rje gshed yab yum khyed rang rnams la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa la slob dpon gyis me tog gi char 'bebs shing rab tu gnas pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha brjod/ me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pas kyang mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ slar yang bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pas kyang mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs shis brjod ji ltar rigs pa bya/ des byin rlabs kyi dngos gzhi mtha' rten bcas legs par grub nas/

dam tshig khas blangs sogs spyi ltar byas la slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang*/ gsum pa ni/ slob dpon gyis gtor mgron la mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ gshegs gsol/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ bsngo smon shis brjod spyi ltar bya'o// dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed kyi// byin rlabs shin tu spros med pa'i// ye shes 'char ba'i rim pa 'dis// 'gro kun lhan cig skyes 'grub shog /ces pa'ang chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab dang 'brel bar byin rlabs bya tshul nyung gsal 'di'ang*/ nye bar mkho ba'i yan lag tu bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba sid+dhi rastu// maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
